description_en: Reruns a completed data validation task to re-execute data comparison and generate a new validation batch
description_zh: 对已完成的校验任务发起重跑，重新执行数据比对并产生新的校验批次
name: ExecDataCheckReRun

parameters.help_en: The batch ID returned by the ExecDataCheckSaveTask operation
parameters.name: batch_id

data.description_en: The ID of the new batch created by the rerun

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, use errCode and errMessage to troubleshoot the issue
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
